name: Sailab Banik
statement: Software engineer with 3+ years building production AI systems — retrieval pipelines, document intelligence, and the full-stack products that put them in front of people.
about: I am a software engineer at ZF Group in Chennai, three years in, working on the AI side of PrimeAI — an internal document processing platform five business teams run on. I own features end to end, from the retrieval and extraction behind an answer to the interface, API, and schema around it. Away from work I build local-first AI systems: retrieval and vision-language extraction that run entirely on infrastructure you control, so sensitive documents never leave the building. Lately I have been taking those systems apart to measure what each piece actually costs.
